description: Image Description: The image depicts a parking meter mounted on a metal pole on a sidewalk. The meter is grey and shows signs of wear, with some paint chipping on the pole. A long shadow of the meter is cast on the concrete sidewalk due to the sunlight. In the background, there are trees without leaves, a stone wall, and a building with white and red accents. Some patches of snow are visible on the ground, suggesting a cold season. The scene is urban, with no people
